title: commodity-search — code tree browse + EPPO species search
recipe: sets/live-animals/docs/add-a-page.md (page shape, controller order, registration) + sets/live-animals/docs/add-a-collection.md batch-split/loop-page steps for the appendEntry/appendEntryAt write path; exemplar feature = sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/search/

filesToTouch.what: Add `export const commoditySearchPage = { id: '<fresh UUID>', slug: 'commodity-search' }` alongside the pp-022 commodityInputMethodPage. page.js stays import-free (controller and flow import the same object).

meta = { ...commoditySearchPage, collects: ['commodityLines'] } (the page owns the commodityLines GROUP; member leaves inherit ownership; species/varieties groups stay owned by their own pages — do NOT add them to collects). GET: state.get() once; read tree position from query (?parent=<chapterCode>, absent = root) and build the render model via view-model.js from the pp-014 fixture service (sets/plant-products/services/commodities/index.js); render BOTH tab panels (proper govuk-tabs — both panels in the DOM, component JS toggles client-side, anchor fallback no-JS; NOT the legacy one-panel-per-request server tabs). POST branches on which submit name arrives (single route, pure POST->302->GET, zero client XHR): (a) action='search-code' — Joi single-layer validation (c-018): required -> 'Enter a commodity code'; numeric -> 'Commodity code must be a number'; then resolve in the fixture — already on the notification (compare committed commodityLines[].commoditySelection) -> 'You cannot add the same commodity code twice' (400); resolves to a selectable code -> append a commodityLines entry { commoditySelection: <code> } via state.appendEntry(request, h, 'commodityLines', entry) wrapped in kit.recoverableSave, redirect via await kit.nextTarget(request, page, committed.scope); no fixture match -> re-render 200 with a 'No results' state (no error summary — legacy fell through silently, we render explicit copy) preserving the raw value. (b) action='search-species' — Joi: required -> 'Enter a genus and species' (400); else re-render with server-built species results (genus/species substring match over the fixture, each result showing genusAndSpecies + its commodity code, with a per-result Add submit named add-species-<speciesId>). (c) add-species-<speciesId> submit — resolve the species in the fixture (refuse forged/stale ids: unknown id re-renders 400), duplicate-code guard as in (a), then append the line ({ commoditySelection: <code> }) AND seed its first species entry via state.appendEntryAt(request, h, ['commodityLines', newIndex, 'species'], { eppoCode, genusAndSpecies }) with parent-index validation (Number.isInteger && in range) before the nested write — eppoCode is THE join key; the add-species-<id> submit name is TRANSIENT UI state and is never committed. (d) tree leaf select — submit name select-code with value=<leafCode>, same append+duplicate path as (a); tree DRILL-DOWN is plain GET links (?parent=<code>), never a POST (fixes the legacy buttons-as-links anti-pattern). Invalid POSTs re-render RAW values, status 400, GDS 'There is a problem' summary with #field links (c-004/c-014). Never port the legacy 'Invalid commodityID' developer string. export const routes = kit.pageRoutes(page, { get, post }).

Named pure helpers so the controller reads as prose: treeLevel(commoditiesFixture, parentCode) -> { crumbs, rows: [{ code, description, isLeaf }] } for the browsable tree (root = chapter list); speciesResults(commoditiesFixture, query) -> [{ speciesId, eppoCode, genusAndSpecies, commodityCode }] (case-insensitive substring on genusAndSpecies); isDuplicateCode(lines, code). All read the pp-014 fixture barrel lazily inside the call, never frozen at module load.

Vitest: GET renders both panels + root tree; GET ?parent drills one level; empty code -> 400 'Enter a commodity code'; non-numeric -> 'Commodity code must be a number'; duplicate -> 'You cannot add the same commodity code twice'; valid code appends { commoditySelection } and redirects via nextTarget; unknown code -> 200 no-results, raw value preserved; empty species -> 400 'Enter a genus and species'; species query renders results; add-species-<id> appends line + seeds species[0].eppoCode/genusAndSpecies; forged add-species id -> 400, no write; forged out-of-range parent index cannot fabricate a phantom instance; raw values re-rendered on every 400; recoverable-save failure -> 500 recoverableError; unexpected errors throw.

Extends shared/layout.njk (unprefixed). Caption 'Description of the goods' (govuk-caption-xl), H1 'Commodity' (legend/heading per c-014). Full-width grid (govuk-grid-column-full) for the tree. Proper govuk-tabs with BOTH panels rendered: panel 1 'Commodity code search' = fieldset legend 'Search commodities', govuk-input name=commoditySearchCode inputmode=numeric width-one-third WITH a govuk-hint ('Enter the 8 or 10 digit commodity code') wired via aria-describedby (legacy had no hint — deliberate fix), govuk-button Search (name=action value=search-code, data-prevent-double-click), then H2 'Find the commodity in the commodity tree', breadcrumb links + chapter/level rows as real govuk-link GET anchors (?parent=<code>) with a govuk-button--secondary Select per leaf (name=select-code value=<code>) — NO bespoke nav-landmark tree, no link-button class, no custom CSS; panel 2 'Genus and species search' = fieldset legend 'Search genus and species of commodity', govuk-input name=speciesSearchTerm with hint 'Use the full scientific name. This will be in Latin, for example, Prunus dulcis' wired via aria-describedby (fixes the legacy missing-aria-describedby defect), Search button (name=action value=search-species), results list with per-row Add submit (name=add-species-<speciesId>). Error summary + inline errors with input name = id = error key so #links focus controls. NO 500-line body paragraph (no cap in the pass-1 model). All text from copy bundles via copyFor.

Add the commoditySearch namespace: title, caption 'Description of the goods', heading 'Commodity', tabs.{codeSearch:'Commodity code search', speciesSearch:'Genus and species search'}, codeSearch.{legend:'Search commodities', label:'Enter commodity code', hint, button:'Search'}, tree.{heading:'Find the commodity in the commodity tree', allCommodities:'All commodities', select:'Select'}, speciesSearch.{legend:'Search genus and species of commodity', label:'Enter genus and species', hint:'Use the full scientific name. This will be in Latin, for example, Prunus dulcis', button:'Search', add:'Add', noResults}, noResults copy, errors.{codeRequired:'Enter a commodity code', codeNumeric:'Commodity code must be a number', codeDuplicate:'You cannot add the same commodity code twice', speciesRequired:'Enter a genus and species'}.
Welsh bundle with the IDENTICAL leaf paths and value kinds (copy-parity enforced).
Extend the group copy test for the new commoditySearch namespace in both locales.

Verify the pp-021 grouped binding for commoditySelection exists — `grouped({ field: 'commoditySelection', obligation: commoditySelection, groups: [commodityLines] })` inside the feature('commodities', ...) bundle; add it if pp-021 left binding registration to the owning page increment. Binding depth must equal the within chain (depth 1 for line members). No new bindings for species/varieties leaves here (pp-024/pp-025 own those pages).
Import the search controller namespace; add its meta to dispatchPages and spread its routes into allRoutes. buildDispatch must accept commodityLines as owned by exactly this page.

Append commoditySearchPage to the 'commodities' section's pages array immediately after commodityInputMethodPage (array order = journey order; §2.3 target order for the section is input-method, search, basic-description, variety, summary, bulk-details — later pages appended by their own increments).

Add commoditySearchPage to the existing 'commodities' task row's pages array (row created by pp-022; NO new row, NO hub GROUPS change). Row status stays derived from collects — the row now unions commodityInputMethod + commodityLines.

Pin the commodities row status transitions with the group in play: Not yet started -> In progress (inputMethod answered, no line) -> still incomplete until the commodityLines minEntries-1 floor is met via collection-complete rollup; row entry page unchanged (input-method).

DECISION EXECUTED (the §3.3 open point assigned to this increment): add 'commoditySelection' to policy.enforcedAtContinue, mirroring the live-animals pair (live-animals policy = ['countryOfOrigin','commoditySelection']). Update/extend the set's policy unit expectation if pp-018 pinned the array.

Verify (add if pp-021 did not): commoditySelection maps to commodity.commodityComplement[].commodityCode with commodityDescription DERIVED from the pp-014 fixture (code -> description) at map time; the add-species-<id> submit-name and any transient UI state never reach the DTO (explicit omission assertion in mapper.test.js). No new DTO fields — commodityCode/commodityDescription/species[].eppoCode/.genusAndSpecies already exist per SCHEMA-DESIGN.

Round-trip case: a line appended by search (commoditySelection + seeded species[0].eppoCode/genusAndSpecies) maps to commodityComplement[0].{commodityCode, commodityDescription(ref-data-derived), species[0].{eppoCode, genusAndSpecies}} and back; omission assertion for transient add-species keys.

Add the search controller's valid-POST case (T-5 standing rule): drive the committing branch (action='search-code' with a valid fixture code), seed importType/inputMethod=MANUAL as needed, assert exactly the committable names in meta.collects (['commodityLines']) are committed.

Co-located Playwright spec (multi-page group -> e2e/ dir), every test starts its own notification, raw role/label locators, no page objects, no sleeps. Scenarios: initial render (caption, H1, both tab labels, code input + hint, Search, tree root chapters from the fixture, species input + Latin-name hint); code-search happy path (fill valid fixture code, Search, redirected via nextTarget, re-enter journey and see the line persisted); tree browse (follow a chapter link, deeper level renders, Select a leaf appends the line); each validation rule in its own test (empty code, non-numeric code, duplicate code, empty species) asserting 'There is a problem' summary, inline error, #link moves focus, raw value preserved; no-results state for an unknown well-formed code (no error summary, entered value preserved); species search happy path (query, results listed with code, Add appends line + species join key; verify by reloading downstream state); duplicate guard on the species-add path; axe (AxeBuilder withTags ['wcag2a','wcag2aa'], fail on serious/critical) for BOTH states — initial render and validation-error state.

acceptanceCriteria: GET /notifications/{journeyId}/commodity-search renders caption 'Description of the goods', H1 'Commodity', and a proper govuk-tabs component with BOTH panels ('Commodity code search', 'Genus and species search') present in the DOM (client-side toggle, anchor fallback) — not the legacy one-panel server-tab pattern
Code panel: label 'Enter commodity code', inputmode=numeric, a format hint covering 8- and 10-digit codes wired via aria-describedby, Search button; page uses the full-width grid

The commodity tree renders the pp-014 fixture's top level as real govuk-link anchors; following a link (GET ?parent=<code>) renders the next level with a breadcrumb back to 'All commodities'; a leaf row's Select submit appends a commodityLines entry — drill-down never POSTs, selection always POSTs

Searching a valid fixture code appends a commodityLines entry ({ commoditySelection }) and redirects via kit.nextTarget (with the section as it stands this resolves to the hub; pp-024 will make it commodity-basic-description with no pp-023 code change)
Empty code search returns 400 with GDS 'There is a problem' summary + inline error 'Enter a commodity code'; the summary link focuses the input; the raw value is preserved
Non-numeric code returns 400 with 'Commodity code must be a number'
A code already on the notification (either path — code search, tree select, or species Add) returns 400 with 'You cannot add the same commodity code twice' and writes nothing

A well-formed code with no fixture match re-renders 200 with an explicit 'No results' state (no error summary) and the entered value preserved — the legacy silent fall-through and the 'Invalid commodityID' developer string are NOT ported

Species panel: label 'Enter genus and species' with hint 'Use the full scientific name. This will be in Latin, for example, Prunus dulcis' wired via aria-describedby (legacy defect fixed); empty submit returns 400 'Enter a genus and species'; a matching query renders server-built results (genusAndSpecies + commodity code) each with an Add submit

Add on a species result appends a commodityLines entry with that species' commodity code and seeds species[0].{eppoCode, genusAndSpecies} via appendEntryAt with parent-index validation; the add-species-<id> submit name is never persisted (mapper omission test proves it); a forged/unknown add-species id is refused with no write

notes: Sam ruling applied (chedpp-requirements residualBlockersResolved): build the REAL commodity search now — code tree browse + EPPO genus/species search, pure server round-trip (connect-src 'self', zero client XHR), fixture-backed via pp-014 (sets/plant-products/services/commodities/). Exemplar for structure: sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/search/{search.controller.js, search.njk, view-model, actions, selection} and its e2e/search.e2e.spec.js — match the idiom (controller order, kit.pageRoutes, recoverableSave, nextTarget) but the interaction differs: CHED-PP appends one line per visit (appendEntry) rather than reconciling a checkbox selection. Design decisions taken headless: (1) tabs rebuilt as PROPER govuk-tabs (both panels rendered, client toggle, anchor no-JS fallback) — the legacy one-panel ?tab= server navigation is a documented anti-pattern; tab state therefore no longer lives in a query param; (2) tree drill-down = GET links with ?parent=<code> (position in the URL, not a posted selectedCommodity hidden), leaf selection = POST submit — replaces the legacy 22 buttons-as-links, the name-as-payload parent_<code> convention, and the nested identically-named nav landmarks (axe/landmark hygiene); (3) code input gains a format hint (8/10 digits — legacy had none while the spec proves both lengths are accepted; validating a fixed 8 would be wrong); (4) species hint properly wired with aria-describedby (legacy WCAG defect not ported); (5) no-match renders an explicit 'No results' state (legacy silently re-rendered; 'Invalid commodityID' is a developer string ruled not-portable); (6) the 500-commodity-line body copy is OMITTED — the pass-1 model declares no cap (SIBLING-SET-PLAN §3.3: policy.maxEntriesFrom = {}); (7) enforcedAtContinue decision (assigned to this increment by §3.3): commoditySelection JOINS policy.enforcedAtContinue, mirroring live-animals; (8) FORM0/commodityDetailsPage/etag legacy artefacts not ported (spec marks them 'do not port until explained'; concurrency is last-write-wins per Open Q 3); (9) duplicate rule enforced on ALL three add paths. Validation copy is verbatim legacy-sourced (c-018 one canonical string per rule): 'Enter a commodity code', 'Commodity code must be a number', 'You cannot add the same commodity code twice', 'Enter a genus and species'. eppoCode is THE join key (Open Q 1); add-species-<id> transient. Write guards per add-a-collection §4.7 (parent-index validation before the nested species seed). Not platform-touching (all edits inside sets/plant-products/ + the plant contract table), so the two-sided live-animals sibling check is not mandated — npm test in the ladder still exercises the shared L1/L2 suites. Redirect note: kit.nextTarget resolves to the hub until pp-024 appends basic-description to the section; that later shift needs no pp-023 code change (one e2e assertion update is pp-024's).
openQuestions: No-results behaviour is unevidenced in legacy (handler fell through silently) — pass-1 renders an explicit 'No results' state with fresh GDS copy; product should confirm the copy and whether a partial-code search should list candidate codes instead

Species-search behaviour beyond the empty-submit message is a double-confirmed legacy gap (no trace or test ever exercises it) — pass-1 defines it as substring match over the fixture with per-result Add; design/product should confirm the results interaction (legacy used an accessible-autocomplete enhancement; pass-1 is no-JS server results per the zero-XHR ruling)

500-commodity-line cap: stated in legacy body copy, enforcement unevidenced, and the pass-1 model declares no cap — confirm whether a cap ever becomes a real CHED-PP rule (it would arrive as a requires/maxEntries model change, not page copy)

The code-format hint (8 or 10 digits) is an addition over legacy (which had no hint but accepted both lengths) — confirm the full set of valid lengths with reference data before the real commodity service replaces the fixture

Tree levels beyond the chapter list are unevidenced in legacy (no trace ever drilled down) — the fixture tree's depth (pp-014) defines the pass-1 browse depth; confirm real reference-data depth when the lookup goes real
